summary_type: Aggregate-only compact export; full original kept locally, no historical axis relabeling

results.oracle_scope: Truth geometry and support are used only in substitution controls. Oracle beta reads J. Blind variants recompute rho on the replaced B while retaining learned log precision.

delay_only_refinement.interpretation: Original S2 uses zero padding when true distinct delays are fewer than eight. This supplemental S2 changes delays only, retains every learned mask, and leaves truly unjammed pulse dictionaries unchanged.
